strings.off_no_server: Timber is inactive: this server does not provide Timber.
strings.camera_no_station: The build camera works only near a crafting station
strings.step_aside_camera: Timber's build camera is off while {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_fires: Timber fires on floors is off: {0} is installed.
strings.step_aside_flooring: Timber flooring is off: {0} is installed.
strings.command_help: Timber: timber import cartur|azumatt|flooring|openkeep [apply]; timber bindings.
strings.bindings_scope: Possible keyboard conflicts among loaded plugins' declared shortcuts. External input contexts, native game bindings and string-based controls are not inferred.
strings.bindings_none: No possible conflicts involving Timber were found in the declared shortcuts.
strings.bindings_tip: Change controls in the mod config through r2modman or Almanac, then run timber bindings again. Timber never remaps them automatically.
strings.import_openkeep_skipped: OpenKeep's section 14 settings are not supported by Timber and were skipped.
strings.import_applied: Imported {0} settings. Timber's previous settings were backed up and the original files are unchanged.
strings.import_collision: Shortcut collision: {0}; supply a binding:<target> override in Almanac.
strings.cfg_build_camera__toggle_key_help: Brings the build camera out and back while a hammer, hoe or cultivator is in hand.
strings.cfg_build_camera__gamepad_toggle_help: The same on a gamepad: the game's button names joined with +, the last pressed while the others are held (by default hold the left trigger and click the right stick). Empty: none.
strings.cfg_build_camera__speed_help: Meters per second the camera flies.
strings.cfg_build_camera__run_multiplier_help: How much faster the camera flies while Run (Shift) is held.
strings.cfg_build_camera__move_with_respect_to_w: Movement follows world axes instead of camera heading.
strings.cfg_build_camera__invert_mouse_horizonta: Reverse horizontal mouse look while the build camera is detached.
strings.cfg_build_camera__invert_mouse_vertical_: Reverse vertical mouse look while the build camera is detached.
strings.cfg_build_camera__invert_pad_horizontal_: Reverse horizontal gamepad look while the build camera is detached.
strings.cfg_build_camera__invert_pad_vertical_he: Reverse vertical gamepad look while the build camera is detached.
strings.cfg_build_camera__pickup_panel_help: Show unmet camera pickup Resting and comfort needs in the shared Meadworks HUD panel.
strings.cfg_build_camera__pickup_panel_position_: Pickup panel offset from the top center of the HUD in UI units: x right, y up.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_light_help: A light worn on the head (the Dvergr circlet, also in another mod's extra slot) shines from the camera too while it is out, with the circlet's own settings unless the three below change them.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_offset_help: Camera light offset: right, up, forward; each clamped to -5 to 5 meters.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_color_help: Original or a hexadecimal RRGGBB[AA] color.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_shadows_help: Original, Off, Hard or Soft shadows.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_intensity_help: Brightness of the camera's copy. 0: the circlet's own.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_range_help: Meters the camera's copy reaches. 0: the circlet's own.
strings.cfg_build_camera__circlet_spot_angle_hel: Width of the camera's copy's beam in degrees. 0: the circlet's own.
strings.cfg_build_camera__enabled_help: With a hammer, hoe or cultivator in hand near a crafting station (a workbench, forge, stonecutter...), Toggle Key detaches the camera from you. Fly it with the movement keys, Jump up, Crouch down, Run faster; build, remove and repair from it as usual. Toggle Key again, Hide (R) or putting the tool away brings it back.
strings.cfg_build_camera__range_multiplier_help: The camera comes out and stays within this many times a station's build range around any crafting station (measured flat as the game does, and as far above or below it). Only the camera's area: pieces still need the station's real range, and the station's base area (raids, comfort) is unchanged.
strings.cfg_build_camera__extra_reach_help: Meters the camera reaches beyond your own building reach (the game's 5 m, or what another mod makes it), measured from the camera, for placing, removing and repairing.
strings.cfg_build_camera__camera_pickup_help: While the camera is out, items lying within the game's auto pickup range of it come into your inventory, as they do around you (only with the game's auto pickup on).
strings.cfg_build_camera__terrain_clearance_help: Camera collision probe radius in meters.
strings.cfg_build_camera__pickup_range_help: Camera auto pickup range in meters. 0: the player's native range.
strings.cfg_build_camera__demister_follow_camera: The equipped Wisplight follows the detached camera.
strings.cfg_build_camera__demister_range_multipl: Wisplight clearing radius while the camera is detached.
strings.cfg_build_camera__entry_needs_resting_he: The camera comes out only while you have the game's Resting effect (by a fire, under a roof).
strings.cfg_build_camera__entry_min_comfort_help: The comfort level you need where you stand to bring the camera out. 0: none.
strings.cfg_build_camera__pickup_needs_resting_h: Camera Pickup works only while you have the game's Resting effect.
strings.cfg_build_camera__pickup_min_comfort_hel: The comfort level you need where you stand for Camera Pickup. 0: none.
strings.cfg_cheats__ignore_support_help: Pieces placed while enabled keep standing without support after it is disabled. Existing pieces are unchanged. Does not prevent rain, fire or attack damage.
strings.cfg_cheats__free_build_help: Hammer pieces (including ships) cost no materials. Pieces must still be learned. Station, DLC and placement checks remain. Does not enable the game no-cost debug mode.
strings.cfg_cheats__build_everywhere_help: Place and remove pieces inside no-build zones (dungeons, villages, boss altars). Wards, stations, support and the other placement checks still apply.
strings.cfg_flooring__fires_on_floors_help: Allow Fireplace and Fire comfort-group pieces on floors. Other placement, support, smoke and fire-spread rules remain native.
strings.cfg_flooring__floors_are_roofs_help: Floors count as a roof for the space below them, sheltering it from rain. Off: floors work as in the game.
strings.cfg_flooring__smelters_on_floors_help: Smelters can be placed on floors, and a smelter on a floor does not break from lack of support. Other damage and material costs are unchanged.
strings.cfg_flooring__floors_dont_decay_help: Floors do not take rain damage. They still look wet, need support, and can burn or be damaged by fire, ash and attacks.
strings.cfg_repair__area_repair_help: After one successful hammer repair, repair damaged pieces touching that piece (at most 64), without spreading through the building. Each neighbor needs its native crafting station and ward access. Only the original swing costs stamina, eitr and hammer wear. A healthy or refused center repairs no neighbors. Timber steps aside while OpenKeep's Area Repair is active.
strings.cfg_server__locked_player_settings_help: Comma-separated Local Section.Key ids whose runtime values follow this server. Empty preserves player choices.
